import http.client,json,pathlib,sys,subprocess
want="84a880150a72bfc4b05559d22c58027f5eeb9feb"
def check(label,ok):
 print(label+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
key=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def get(path):
 conn=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  conn.request("GET",path,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+key})
  r=conn.getresponse();return r.status,r.read(200000)
 finally:conn.close()
actual=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
check("CHECKOUT_SHA",actual==want)
status,body=get("/healthz")
check("LIVE_SHA",status==200 and json.loads(body).get("commit")==want)
for target in ("/library","/oauth/status","/discovery/candidates"):
 status,body=get(target)
 check("OWNER_API_"+target,status==200 and isinstance(json.loads(body),dict))
for suite in ("test_discovery_engine.py","test_discovery.py","test_assistant.py","test_operation_app.py"):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",suite,"-q"],capture_output=True,timeout=45)
 check("REAL_GSERVER_OFFLINE_"+suite,p.returncode==0)
print("NO_REAL_PROVIDER_POST=PASS")
print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS")
